name: Finding Rexxar

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: Across Desolace, the adventurers seek Rexxar, a wandering champion of the Horde. His place between the wilds and settled life makes him the guide to a difficult next task. Here the great campaign narrows to a search for one champion moving through an immense, sparse land. Rexxar sets the terms for learning how an adventurer might pass the protections around Onyxia’s lair.
